integrity: The theorem is established by a stopped-martingale proof; exact rational finite-state checks and seeded experiments are supporting reproducibility, not proof of the asymptotic. No independent validation or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The substrate is a dense complete bipartite graph. Only equal independent rates per distinct three-vertex path are proved; no planar-lattice law, finite-size convergence rate, or expectation asymptotic is claimed. Priority is qualified to accessible comparisons.
title: A quarter-power jamming law for random three-site adsorption on complete bipartite networks
